calculation.description: Cross-sectional reversal of the completed five-session asset return, scaled by the contemporaneous completed five-session VIX change. Positive VIX trend increases reversal magnitude; non-rising VIX halves it. VIX is lagged/aligned to the decision date and no future observations are used.

validation.regime_notes: Daily ICIR clears the benchmark gates, with positive annual IC in 2020-2026; weakest stability occurred in 2025. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
